caller_tactics.text: Hello, Eszter? It's Ruth Adeyemi from Alderbrook Pension Services. This is your yearly check-in call about your workplace pension.
Your statement shows a balance of about ninety-two thousand dollars, with contributions from your former employer and a small amount from you.
The plan charges an annual management fee of about point six percent, which is deducted from the fund value each year.
The figure in the statement includes the fund's charge. The total annual cost is shown on the second page.
Yes, you can, but it's your decision. We can send you the transfer information pack, which lists any charges.
That's fine. There is no need to make any change. We simply need to confirm your nominated beneficiary details.
Thank you. I've noted that. Would you like the statement by post, or in your online account?
No problem. I'll mark that for you. The next statement will arrive in March.
Just that you can check your fund choices online at any time, and call us with any questions.
